description: [RFI] Fifteen years after France promised a new relationship with Africa, Paris is still struggling to reconcile its rejection of colonial-era interference with its desire to retain influence on the continent. RFI Africa specialist Christophe Boisbouvier argues in a new book that France can still build a partnership of equals - based on respect rather than arrogance or domination.
title: Africa: 'Too Arrogant, Too Sure of Itself' France Confronts Its Legacy in Africa

description: [The Conversation Africa] Conversations around health progress in Africa usually focus on lives saved. And rightly so. Across the continent, people are living longer than they did a generation ago. Advances in prevention, treatment and public health have reduced deaths from many major diseases and improved survival for millions. But there is another side to this success story that receives far less attention: quality of life.
title: Africa: Health Progress in Africa Leaves More People Living With Disabilities - Rehabilitation Is the Next Challenge

description: [RFI] The latest Ebola outbreak has killed nearly 4,700 people and is still spreading, with Nigeria recording its first case in more than a decade. title: Africa: Africa CDC Chief Warns 'No Country Is Safe' As Ebola Reaches Nigeria
